task.name: Inspect_flame_effect_system
task.when: Before the first flame-effect startup each day

step.action: Confirm that the operator and spotter are at least 21, trained for this effect, unimpaired, and wearing 🔥 Fire_Resistant_Clothing.
step.ifThen: IF any condition is not met, THEN do not operate the effect.
IF the current physical license is not present, THEN do not test or operate the effect.

step.action: Confirm that 🔥 Flame_Effect_Operating_Procedure is the Flame Lead-approved current revision.
Clear combustible and flammable material from the FAST-approved perimeter and at least 20 feet around the effect.
Confirm that the audience boundary and operator zone match the FAST-approved layout.

step.ifThen: IF wind can carry flame or heat toward people, structures, or outside the approved perimeter, THEN do not operate the effect.

step.action: Inspect the effect structure, guards, anchors, and vehicle protection for movement or damage.
Inspect every cylinder for current certification, upright securement, excessive rust, damage, and intact valve protection.
Inspect every visible hose and fitting for cracks, abrasion, looseness, heat damage, or an unrated component.
Confirm that the primary quarter-turn emergency shutoff is visible, labeled, accessible, and in the OFF position.
Confirm that every other valve and control is in the pre-operation position shown in 🔥 Flame_Effect_Operating_Procedure.
Confirm that the flame-effect fire extinguisher is visible, unobstructed, charged, and rated for flammable gas.
Confirm that 🔥 Flame_Effect_First_Aid_Kit and 🔥 Flame_Effect_SDS are available outside the perimeter.
Leak-test every connection exactly as specified in 🔥 Flame_Effect_Operating_Procedure.
step.ifThen: IF growing bubbles, propane odor, hissing, frost, or another failed inspection condition is present, THEN keep the system shut down and tell the Flame Lead.

step.action: Record the inspection result in 🔥 Flame_Effect_Log.

passWhen.criterion: The licensed operator and trained spotter meet every operator requirement.
The current burn license and operating procedure are present.
The approved perimeter is clear and current wind is acceptable.
No structural, cylinder, hose, fitting, valve, control, or leak-test failure is present.
Fire suppression, first-aid supplies, SDSs, and the inspection record are ready.

reasoning.entry: The workbook's Morning fire-pit and vaporizer-hose checks are part of the mandatory daily flame-system inspection.
